tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: App ground between panels and the splitter gap. No text directly on it.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panel body: properties panel, texture browser, log, toolbar.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: panel title bars, inputs, menus, floating windows.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover state on surface-2 and pressed buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel borders, table cell rules, separators. Decorative; never the only sign of a state.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and button borders (≥3:1 on surface-1 and surface-2 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface-0 to surface-3.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: coordinates, metadata, empty fields, the (new key) row. On surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Unavailable menu items and buttons. Exempt from 4.5:1 (WCAG: inactive components).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Active view, highlighted menu row, selected tab, primary button. Qoole's blue active-window title bar. As text, on surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a selected row in trees and lists when the selection is not focused.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring after a 1px gap. ≥3:1 on every surface token.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: Selected item in the UI: the selected texture's name label, the selected node's marker. Means the same as vp-select in the viewports.

tokens.name: on-select
tokens.usage: Text on a select fill.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning: Tex Lock error over 0.5 texels, surface flag differing from the texture default, compiler warning in the log. As text on surface-1 and surface-2; always with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error: compile error, leak, rejected geometry. As text on surface-1 and surface-2; always with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Successful compile in the log. Blue, not green, so ok and error differ without relying on red–green.

tokens.name: vp-bg
tokens.usage: Background of all four views in both themes, as in Qoole.

tokens.name: vp-grid-minor
tokens.usage: Grid lines at the current grid size. Fade out when spacing drops below 4px.

tokens.name: vp-grid-major
tokens.usage: Every 8th grid line and every 64 units.

tokens.name: vp-axis
tokens.usage: World origin axes (x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) in the 2D views.

tokens.name: vp-brush
tokens.usage: Unselected brush wireframe in the 2D views and 3D wireframe mode.

tokens.name: vp-select
tokens.usage: Selected brush or entity in every view. Selection is never shown in any other color.

tokens.name: vp-entity
tokens.usage: Point entities in the 2D views when the entity definition gives no color.

tokens.name: vp-target
tokens.usage: target/targetname link lines in the 2D views, dashed.

tokens.name: vp-handle
tokens.usage: Vertex, edge and face handles, and clip plane points.

tokens.name: vp-face
tokens.usage: The texture tool's focused face: outline in every view and translucent fill in 3D. The one exception to the rule that selection is only red.

tokens.name: vp-invalid
tokens.usage: Rejected move (non-convex result), drawn dashed. Not red, because red is reserved for selection.

tokens.name: vp-leak
tokens.usage: qbsp3 leak path (.pts) in every view.

tokens.name: vp-sky
tokens.usage: SURF_SKY faces in the 3D view.

tokens.name: vp-toolface
tokens.usage: SURF_NODRAW, clip and hint faces in the 3D view, dimmed (drawn at 35% opacity).

tokens.name: vp-scope-dim
tokens.usage: The rest of the map while inside a group (scope): wireframe in this color.

tokens.name: vp-label
tokens.usage: Text drawn over a view: measurements, handle coordinates.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: ui-heading
styles.usage: Floating window and panel group titles.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: Menus, buttons, forms, tree view. The default style.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels inside a panel.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Texture names, title bar coordinates, grid size.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and edge in a button; handle radius.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Tight padding: tabs, gap between toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Horizontal cell padding in tables and menu row indent.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between texture tiles.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Floating window padding, gap between groups in a panel.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in the properties panel.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Views, panels and splitters. The workspace is a rectangular grid.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs, texture tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus and floating windows.

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Height of panel and view title bars.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Menu row, table row, tree row.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Button, input, select.

tokens.name: size-toolbar
tokens.usage: Toolbar height.

tokens.name: size-thumb
tokens.usage: Texture browser thumbnail (default; 32–128px).

tokens.name: size-splitter
tokens.usage: Width of a draggable panel splitter.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, submenus and floating windows. Every other surface is flat.
